Question
========

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="hide"}
## --- Randomise values -------------------------------------------------
## Draw all random pieces here, then interpolate every number with `r ...`
## so the prose, the options, and the solution stay consistent.
a <- sample(2:9, 1)
b <- sample(2:9, 1)
correct <- a * b

## --- Options + solution vector ---------------------------------------
## Build distractors FROM the random values by applying a wrong operation,
## so each distractor encodes a specific, plausible mistake.
answers <- c(
  paste0("$", correct, "$"),        # correct: a * b
  paste0("$", a + b, "$"),          # added instead of multiplied
  paste0("$", a * b + a, "$"),      # off-by-a-term slip
  paste0("$", abs(a - b), "$")      # subtracted
)
sol <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)

explanations <- c(
  paste0("Correct. $", a, " \\times ", b, " = ", correct, "$."),
  paste0("Incorrect. This adds the two numbers ($", a, " + ", b, "$) instead of multiplying them."),
  "Incorrect. This adds an extra term that does not belong in the product.",
  paste0("Incorrect. This subtracts the two numbers instead of multiplying them.")
)
```

Compute the product $`r a` \times `r b`$.

```{r questionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
answerlist(answers, markup = "markdown")
```

Solution
========

The product is $`r a` \times `r b` = `r correct`$.

```{r solutionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
answerlist(explanations, markup = "markdown")
```
